about: The skeleton of every apple tree design of the orchard, written by source-art/models/orchard/apple_trees.py. All in the tree's own space as the ride sees it: x, y up, z (metres), the water at y = 0, the trunk on the origin. limbs: o = order (1 scaffold, 2 bough or leader, 3 lateral), p = x, y, z, radius for each point; ends, spurs: x, y, z, dx, dy, dz; perch: x, y, z; label: where a label's wire hangs; crown: where the blossom's masses belong, as kit_blossom.js reads a crown (lobes: x, y = its level underside, z, w = across, tall, turn, role, az).
